skills.name: browser-use
skills.source: EMB-187 operator Browser Use CLI guidance
use_when: active Symphony role is Agent QA

owning issue has browser-facing acceptance criteria or QA evidence would materially benefit from browser runtime checks, screenshots, page-state inspection, form-flow verification, or manual acceptance support
local Browser Use CLI or local stdio MCP can run without Browser Use Cloud, hosted browser infrastructure, BROWSER_USE_API_KEY, LLM provider keys, or new operator-provisioned secrets
do_not_use_when: active Symphony role is implementer, reviewer, landing, backlog processor, or operator
the desired Browser Use mode requires Browser Use Cloud, a hosted browser service, BROWSER_USE_API_KEY, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or another LLM provider key
no local browser or local Browser Use tooling is available and existing Playwright/browser tooling or manual inspection is sufficient

octo_authority_boundaries: Linear repository metadata remains the repository source of truth
work must stay on the issue branch
role workflow state transitions remain authoritative
PR ownership and issue linkage remain authoritative
the mutable Codex Workpad and immutable Symphony Handoff trail remain authoritative
validation requirements from the issue, specs, ADRs, workpad, and handoff remain authoritative
durable QA artifacts for Linear-backed workflows must be attached to Linear
Human Escalation routing remains authoritative when required browser-facing acceptance cannot be verified through a no-key local path
